“ ‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not…
You shall not do so to Yahweh your God; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods…
However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this…
and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things…
But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
So you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise.

translations.web: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God hates.
translations.bsb: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
translations.kjv: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.
translations.asv: Neither shalt thou set thee up a pillar; which Jehovah thy God hateth.
